audit_items.proof_trace: burn_ctokens computes redeem_collateral_amount via int_mul(exchange_rate, ctokens.value()), which evaluates to (exchange_rate.value * ctokens) / WAD using u256 integer division — this truncates toward zero, i.e., floor for all positive inputs. The exchange_rate itself is also computed with floor-truncating division (div uses (a.value * WAD) / b.value). No ceiling path exists anywhere in the redeem or withdraw_underlying code.
